title: Trie: Longest Common Prefix
statement:
Given a list of words, find the longest common prefix (LCP) shared by all words.

If there is no common prefix, print an empty line.

Use a Trie: insert all words; walk the trie from root as long as each node has exactly one child and that node is not a word end.
inputFormat:
The first line contains W.
The next W lines each contain a word.
outputFormat: A single line: the longest common prefix (may be empty).
constraints:
1 <= W <= 200
1 <= |word| <= 50
All words are lowercase letters.

examples.explanation: No common prefix; print empty line.

starterCode.python:
w = int(input())
words = [input().strip() for _ in range(w)]
